caveats.clear_water: Clear-water modelling; sediment and debris are not represented.
caveats.moraine_extrapolation: Moraine-dam results extrapolate beyond the calibration data.
caveats.caveat_arrival_depth_not_joint: Arrival and depth percentiles are marginal estimates, not a joint distribution.
caveats.direct_solver_output: Direct solver output; confidence is LOW and this result is not scientifically validated.
caveats.preview_illustrative: Illustrative preview data — not a real solver or emulator result.
caveats.nearfield_arrival_from_section_inflow: Near-field arrival is timed from when flow enters this section, not from the upstream breach.
caveats.comparison_metrics_illustrative: Illustrative comparison computed by the demo engine.
caveats.nearfield_arrival_travel_time_proxy: Arrival times here are estimated from travel time (distance ÷ velocity). A negative difference means SPH arrives sooner.
caveats.scenario_no_probabilities: Scenario mode runs the low and high breach estimates separately. HIGH = flooded in the low estimate; POSSIBLE = flooded only in the high estimate.
caveats.far_field_arrival_travel_time_proxy: Arrival times are estimated from travel time along the valley.
caveats.interval_label_p5_p95_not_p10_p90: The range shown is the 5th–95th percentile of the Monte Carlo ensemble.
caveats.outside_trained_range: This query falls outside the emulator's trained input range.
caveats.downgrade_cell_example: Where the ensemble spread is very wide, a HIGH cell is shown as POSSIBLE so certainty is not overstated.
caveats.recheck_change_pct_illustrative: The lake-area change shown is illustrative. The library is flagged for a re-run when the lake area changes by more than 10%.
caveats.lake_area_series_illustrative: This site has no published lake-area source; the series below is illustrative.
caveats.mass_flow_approximation: This event was a rock-ice avalanche / mass flow, not a dam breach or GLOF. Any breach-style prediction shown alongside it is an approximation the project's clear-water pipeline cannot really represent.
caveats.event_model_not_defined: Event model for Chamoli 2021 not yet defined; comparison layout only.
caveats.observed_data_sparse: Only the point-in-time and point-location values reported in the source paper are shown; no gridded observed depth, extent or time-series is available for this event.
caveats.skill_illustrative_not_emulator_estimate: The emulator skill shown here is illustrative.
caveats.outside_trained_range_example: This example is placed 10% outside the trained range to show the confidence rule marking it LOW.
caveats.timeline_single_solver: Playback frames are selected snapshots from one real solver run; HIGH/POSSIBLE aliases are not uncertainty bands.
caveats.mvp_reconstructed_forcing: The South Lhonak forcing is an MVP reconstruction, not an observed hydrograph.
caveats.single_run_impact: Impact is calculated from one deterministic run. The POSSIBLE column is the run footprint, not an uncertainty probability.
caveats.impact_exposure_coverage: Exposure has limited or unrecorded coverage; missing asset classes are not assessed.
caveats.placeholder_data: Some impact inputs remain placeholders, so monetary loss is unavailable.
caveats.caveat_loss_national_average: JRC max-damage values are 2010 national averages for India; Himalayan stone or timber-built houses may cost quite differently to rebuild — loss is a rough estimate, not a precise valuation.
caveats.population_density_illustrative: Population and building counts use an illustrative density for this valley.
caveats.emulator_input_placeholders: Some breach inputs are still placeholders, so confidence is capped at MODERATE.
caveats.loss_config_docs_stale: Loss uses the exchange rate and price index from the impact configuration.
caveats.dem_depression_ponding: The maximum depth sits in an unconditioned DEM depression that traps water rather than a hydraulic peak; the source terrain was never hydrologically conditioned.
caveats.clear_water_steep_reach_velocity: The maximum velocity is clear-water Manning flow on a steep gorge reach; it is not necessarily representative of a debris-laden event.
caveats.poi_grid_snapping: Some places show no flooding next to a wet cell. This is likely the 90 m grid missing the channel there, not the place being safe.
caveats.comparison_unavailable: No paired solver comparison is available for this run.
caveats.no_observed_extent: No observed flood-extent outline has been digitized for this event; extent metrics (IoU/F1) are not available.
caveats.literature_comparison_only: Point values below are compared with other published model reconstructions, not with direct field observations.
